notes: The loop is gather resources, upgrade your own island, unlock, rebirth — Simulation's sandbox-tycoon family — while the 90-second global events that everyone has to live through (meteor shower, zombie invasion, giant boss) are real Survival content, so Survival is named second and contributes spawner-npc for the invasions on top of Simulation's own hazard-kill for the environmental events. The shape is plot-isolated because the author settled it: eight equally spaced per-player islands in one server, each growing from 16x16 to 48x48 studs, never overlapping a neighbour; island-cluster carries the fact that they are separate landmasses with open air between them, and that is where the CHECK comes from. Deciding without a user: the eight islands, the hub and the Golden Island all co-exist in one readable floating arena, so this is one map and not P4 — the Golden Island is simply whichever player island is currently on top, reached by the portal the author described, which I emitted as teleporter-link even though neither loaded file defines that ID. The CHECK should clear if the islands are kept at a single play height rather than stacked in layers, and the stated counts and sizes plus the animation, particle, UI and drop-rate work are recorded here because none of them are layout picks.
